suggestions: narai-primitives 2.1.2's `runSchema` (in dispatcher.js) calls `driver.getSchema(conn, ...)` — the SYNC method — instead of `driver.getSchemaAsync(...)`. PostgresDriver.getSchema returns [] unconditionally; only getSchemaAsync hits information_schema. As a result, the `schema` action against postgres always returns an empty `tables[]` despite a successful connection. The eval works around this by using the `query` action with explicit SELECT against information_schema; doc-wiki users running 'show me tables' on postgres via the schema action will hit the same empty result. Worth raising upstream for a 2.1.3 patch.
eval_feedback.overall: 10/10. End-to-end gather() success path against a real postgres works. Planner -> spawn db subprocess -> NARAI_CONFIG_BLOB carries the slice -> _loadFromConnectorConfig parses it -> registerEnvironment -> _resolveCredentials reads env:POSTGRES_PASSWORD via parseCredentialRef -> pg driver connects to localhost:5455 -> BEGIN READ ONLY + SELECT -> 'users' returned. No leaked connections. No cleartext password anywhere in the wiki tree. Caveat: the `schema` action is broken on postgres in 2.1.2 (sync vs async getSchema mismatch); we use `query` instead. Worth filing upstream.
